title: Bahia vs Remo: Lineups, Points, and Expectations
seoTitle: Bahia vs Remo: Lineups, Points & Expectations
subtitle: What is at stake in Round 27 of the Brasileirão
excerpt: Bahia host Remo this Monday at Arena Fonte Nova, aiming for the top four, while Leão Azul battle to escape the relegation zone.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Next Monday at 8:00 p.m., Bahia will face Remo at Arena Fonte Nova in Salvador to wrap up Round 27 of the Campeonato Brasileiro. The clash carries distinct expectations for both clubs: the Tricolor are looking to close in on the G4, while the Leão Azul are trying to mount a comeback to avoid the relegation zone.

Bahia: Points and Absences

Bahia enter the matchup spurred by three consecutive victories and a 10-game unbeaten run in the national tournament. In the previous round, the Tricolor came from behind to defeat RB Bragantino and opened Round 27 in fifth place with 43 points. With another three points, the squad would leapfrog Fluminense and break into the top four.

For the match, head coach Rogério Ceni will have only two absences: Erick, suspended due to an accumulation of three yellow cards, and Léo Vieira, who continues treatment in the medical department. Jean Lucas is expected to take Erick's spot in midfield, while newly signed goalkeeper Mateo Sanabria is training normally and could be named to the matchday squad.

Remo: Situation and Absences

Remo sit in 19th place with 23 points, just two points ahead of bottom-placed Chapecoense. The Leão Azul have gone winless in eight Série A matches, recording three defeats and two draws in their last five fixtures. Their most recent victory came on July 26 against Vitória at the Mangueirão.

Regarding their squad selection, head coach Léo Condé will be missing two players: Marcelinho, suspended after receiving his third yellow card, and Edson Fernando, who was sent off after the final whistle against Flamengo. Remo's away form remains an issue, with only two wins, three draws, and eight defeats in 13 matches.

Predicted Lineups

Bahia: Ronaldo; Roman Gómez, David Duarte, Marco Moreno (Kanu), and Luciano Juba; Acevedo, Jean Lucas, and Rodrigo Nestor; Erick Pulga, Alejo Veliz, and Kike Olivera. Head Coach: Rogério Ceni.

Remo: Marcelo Rangel; Matheus Alexandre, Marllon, Tchamba, and Marlon; Picco, Patrick, and Zé Ricardo; Yago Pikachu, Gabriel Taliari, and Galeano. Head Coach: Léo Condé.

What Changes in Your Pocket When the Match Happens

For fans watching the game on television or digital platforms, the fixture promises a tactical spectacle, with both coaches tailoring their lineups to compensate for absences. Points expectations can influence betting markets and broadcasts, while on-pitch performance can impact player motivation and fan morale.

With reporting from ge, Terra.
